text:
Michelle: Heads up — observed repeated tiny evictions in eu-west1a this morning, looks correlated with warm-pool ramp. Pods get preempted then quickly rescheduled on the same rack.
Raj: saw that too. NIC TX spikes on 10.40.2.x during bursts, multiple small pods losing affinity.
Kevin: timeline pls? need to know if this is scheduler churn or network flakiness.
Michelle: rough timeline: 08:12:02 node-ready flip, 08:12:07 kubelet reconnect, 08:12:09 scheduler evict+bind. So 2–8s window.
Carmen: logs show kubelet status briefly NotReady for 3-6s, not hitting memory/pressure thresholds.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3769 - eu-west1a transient node-ready flips (auto-detected).
Raj: my guess: warm-pool scale-ups + rack egress saturation -> packet drops -> short control-plane disconnect -> nodes appear NotReady -> scheduler preempts.
Kevin: that matches the `netdev` counters I pulled earlier. We also saw bounces on conntrack counts.
Michelle: quick mitigation idea: add a short rebalance/eviction dampening window so we don't immediately re-evict pods that were just moved. e.g. ignore nodes with recent evictions <30s.
Carmen: could be good but watch out for real resource exhaustion — we don't want to hide real overload.
Raj: alternative short-term: throttle warm-pool ramp rate and bump egress QOS for the affected rack. That reduces the spike driver.
Kevin: longer-term: scheduler-level dampener + annotation on pods/nodes marking last-evict-ts. Pseudocode:
```yaml
# node annotation example
metadata:
  annotations:
    infra.redwood/last-evict-ts: "2026-03-18T08:12:09Z"
```
Scheduler logic: if node.annotation.last-evict-ts > now - 30s then skip as source for aggressive rebalancing.
Michelle: I like the two-pronged approach: immediate rate-limit + QOS bump, medium-term scheduler change + observable.
Carmen: agree. I'll also add an egress-saturation alert so we detect before node-ready flips.
Raj: action items (short):
- Raj: throttle warm-pool speed in eu-west1a by 50% and apply QOS bump to rack egress — starting now, ETA 15m.
- Kevin: start scheduler dampener branch and prototype annotation logic — ETA EOD. Branch: scheduling/dampener-6062.
- Carmen: add egress saturation alert (alert on tx util > 85% for 1m) — ETA 1h.
Michelle: Raj — confirm when throttle live.
Raj: doing warm-pool throttle now :hourglass_flowing_sand: (updating cluster policy).
ops-bot: INC-2026-3769 status -> mitigated (auto-update).
Michelle: checking metrics — NIC TX dropped ~40% after throttle, pod eviction rate back to baseline.
Kevin: prototyping patch, pushing small TTL check to scheduler; will open PR once tests pass.
Carmen: filing follow-up design doc for dampener + false-positive corner cases.
Michelle: great — I'll own RFC + rollout plan. cc @Kevin @Raj.
sre-oncall: acked, will monitor for 30m and escalate if we see another flip.
